title: genesis-tip — P50: Temporal Integrity Probe for LLM behavioural consistency
description: Measures whether LLM agents' text outputs remain internally consistent when temporal context is manipulated (shuffled, gapped, contradicted). Outputs consistency scores hypothesised to rank-correlate (Spearman rho >= 0.3, n >= 30) with Rho_sem from scope-resilience (P41). Pre-registration anchor: commit 1cf1730 (multi-scale-somatic-coherence, 2026-07-15). Standalone extraction of genesis-mssc's (P49) mssc.tip module. Part of the GenesisAeon ecosystem (P50, domain: LLM-evaluation).
